items.headline: Iran: Teen ko phansi, January virodh ka mamla
items.detail: Iran ki nyaypalika ne kaha, January ke virodh-pradarshanon ke dauraan Israel-America ke liye kaam karne ke aarop me teen logon ko phansi di gayi; Supreme Court ne saza barkarar rakhi thi, aath anyon ko 5–10 saal ki saza.
items.exam_angle: Mrityudand aur manavadhikar — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Giza: Train takkar me 64 ghayal
items.detail: Giza ke Al-Ayyat jile me Giza-Fayoum train peeche se Cairo-Aswan train se takrayi, ek train patri se utri; swasthya mantralaya ke mutabik 64 ghayal, maut ki abhi koi pushti nahi.
items.exam_angle: Rail suraksha aur haadsa prabandhan — parivahan aur shasan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: MEXC: America ne crypto exchange par rok lagayi
items.detail: America ke FinCEN ne MEXC crypto exchange ko US banks se kaatne ka aadesh diya — May 2021 se May 2026 ke beech $16.7 arab ke sandigdh len-den ka aarop; rok Federal Register me prakashan ke 30 din baad lagu hogi.
items.exam_angle: Crypto par niyaman, money laundering aur pratibandh — banking aur arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Krakow: Goli baari me 6 ki maut
items.detail: Poland ke Krakow ke Main Market Square me shanivaar ko ek bandukdhari ne goliyaan chalaayi — 6 ki maut, 16 ghayal; hamlaawar ko police ne goli maari aur giraftaar kiya, uske ghar se teen aur shav mile; desh me do din ka rashtriya shok ghoshit.
items.exam_angle: Europe me banduk hinsa aur hathiyaron ka kanoon — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Zaporizhzhia: Parmanu plant phir andhere me
items.detail: Zaporizhzhia parmanu sanyantra ki baahari bijli 8 November ko subah 2:36 baje phir band ho gayi — saal ki 16vi baar; diesel generator se cooling jaari hai, IAEA ke mutaabik vikiran star samanya hai.
items.exam_angle: Parmanu suraksha aur IAEA ki bhoomika — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Senegal: Naav doobne se 21 ki maut
items.detail: Senegal ke uttar-paschimi tat par pravasiyon ki naav doob gayi — kam se kam 21 ki maut, ek ko bachaya gaya; grih mantralaya ke mutaabik mrityu sankhya asthayi hai, khoj jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Africa se Europe ka Atlantic pravasi marg aur samudri suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Africa: Peela bukhar, nau deshon me faila
items.detail: WHO ke mutaabik 2026 me nau African deshon me peele bukhar ke 67 pusht mamle aur 18 mautein darj hui; kshetriya jokhim madhyam aur vaishvik jokhim kam aanka gaya.
items.exam_angle: WHO, IHR 2005 aur EYE Strategy — swasthya aur antarrashtriya sangathan ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: US Department of Agriculture, Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: COP31: Guterres ne 'moment of truth' kaha
items.detail: Sanyukt Rashtra mahasachiv Guterres ne COP31 (9–20 November, Turkey) ko 'moment of truth' kaha; yeh unka aakhri COP hai, karyakal December me khatm ho raha hai.
items.exam_angle: COP31 aur Paris Agreement ka 1.5°C lakshya — jalvayu parivartan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Ukraine: Hamlo se 8.5 lakh andhere me
items.detail: Russia ke raat bhar ke hamlo ke baad Dnipropetrovsk me 6 lakh se zyada aur Kharkiv me lagbhag 2.5 lakh log bijli se vanchit hue; Zelenskyy ne kaha hamle Abu Dhabi vaarta se pehle dabaav ke liye hain.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur urja suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran: Missile range ki seema hataayi
items.detail: IRGC pravakta Mohebbi ne kaha 2,000 km ki swayam-lagayi missile seema 'hata di gayi hai'; unhone yeh nahi bataya ki Iran ke paas isse lambi doori ki missile hai ya nahi.
items.exam_angle: Iran ka missile karyakram aur aprasar — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hormuz: Do tanker mine se takraakar jal uthe
items.detail: IRGC ke daave ke mutaabik do tel tanker Hormuz me mine se takraakar jal uthe; swatantra pushti abhi baaki hai, aur jahazon ke naam nahi bataye gaye.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg aur America-Iran tanav — urja suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Riyadh: Houthi missile roke gaye
items.detail: Saudi gathbandhan ne Riyadh ki taraf daage gaye do ballistic aur do cruise missile rok diye; rajdhani me dhamakon ki awaaz suni gayi, Aramco imarat ko nuksan ki khabar hai.
items.exam_angle: Saudi-Yemen sangharsh aur Khadi me tel suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hong Kong: Joshua Wong ko 10 saal
items.detail: Hong Kong High Court ne Joshua Wong ko videshi shaktiyon se milibhagat ke aarop me 10 saal ki saza di; 10 deshon ne sanyukt bayan me 'anyaypurna mukadme' khatm karne ko kaha.
items.exam_angle: Hong Kong National Security Law aur loktantra — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: FATF: Scam compounds par global action
items.detail: FATF ne scam compounds se jude avaidh vittiya pravah par landmark report jaari ki — har saal arabon dollar ka nuksan; 120 case studies, 60 se zyada desh shamil.
items.exam_angle: FATF, money laundering aur cyber fraud — vittiya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Taiz: Bazaar par hamle me 25 ki maut
items.detail: Taiz ke Al-Hadhara bazaar par hamle me kam se kam 25 log mare aur 30 ghayal hue; Houthis ne Saudi par aarop lagaya, sarkari balon ne Houthis par — zimmedari par vivaad hai.
items.exam_angle: Yemen grih yuddh aur Saudi-Houthi sangharsh — Madhya Purv ki suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Vance: Iran se yuddhviram vaarta me lage
items.detail: Axios ke mutaabik Up-Rashtrapati Vance pichhle do hafte se Qatar aur Pakistan ke madhyam se Iran ke saath apratyaksh vaarta me hain — naye yuddhviram aur parmanu vaarta ki koshish.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav aur Madhya Purv me kootneeti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: October 2026: Record garmi, 1.5°C paar
items.detail: Copernicus ke mutaabik October 2026 sabse garam October raha — 15.35°C, audyogik-kaal se 1.75°C zyada; 2026 lagbhag tay hai 1.5°C se upar jaane wala doosra saal banega.
items.exam_angle: Paris Agreement ka 1.5°C lakshya aur jalvayu parivartan — paryavaran ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Thailand: Do Uyghur ko China bhejane par rok
items.detail: Amnesty aur Human Rights Watch ne Thailand se kaha do Uyghur purushon ko China na bheje; Thailand ne kaha faisla adalat karegi, pehle aupchaarik pratyarpan anurodh chahiye.
items.exam_angle: Non-refoulement aur sharanarthi suraksha — antarrashtriya manavadhikar ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Oman ki khaadi: UAE ne 22 log bachaye
items.detail: Oman ki khaadi me maalvahak jahaz me aag lagne par UAE National Guard ne 22 arab nagrikon ko bachaya; sabhi sthir haalat me hain.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz ke aas-paas samudri suraksha — antarrashtriya vyapar ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Syria: Yemen sainik bhejne se inkaar
items.detail: Damascus ne kaha Yemen ko sainik bhejne ki khabrein bebuniyad hain; Saudi se sahyog sirf prashikshan aur salah tak simit rahega.
items.exam_angle: Mecca Pact aur Madhya Purv me badalti Saudi-Syria dosti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America: Iraq se Iran seema band karne ko kaha
items.detail: America ne Iraq se kaha Iran ke saath sirf do seema crossing khule rakhe; Tehran-samarthak milicia ke samarthan par sainya karravai ki chetavni bhi di.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav me Iraq ki bhoomika — Madhya Purv ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Italy: Mantri ka data dark web par
items.detail: Videsh Mantri Tajani ne kaha Russia-samarthak hackers ne unka niji data dark web par daala; Ukraine samarthan ko wajah bataya, Moscow ne tippani nahi ki.
items.exam_angle: Hybrid warfare aur cyber suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Canada: 2027 tak 6.22 lakh PR
items.detail: Budget 2026 ke tahat Canada 2027 tak 6,22,000 naye permanent residents ko jagah dega, jinme 2 lakh asthayi nivasi bhi shamil hain.
items.exam_angle: Canada ki immigration policy aur Bharatiya pravasi — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Oman ki khaadi: America ne jahaz ko roka
items.detail: CENTCOM ke mutaabik, M/V Huda ne naaka todne ki koshish ki to America ne uske pichhle hisse par hamla kar use roka.
items.exam_angle: Iran par America ki samudri naakaabandi July se jaari hai
